page.overview:
Who is Mo'ang?

Mo'ang wore a golden helmet and a treasure belt, and wielded a three-cornered club.

When Ao Guang was informed by Sun Wukong that his nephew the Water Lizard Dragon had taken over Black Water River, he sent Mo'ang and his army to arrest him. Mo'ang easily did so after a very short battle.
